Claims Department

Re: Claim C-1097 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our office represents Todd Lee in connection with the rear-end collision that occurred on 2023-08-13, when the
vehicle operated by your insured struck the rear of our client's vehicle while it was stopped in traffic. The impact was
forceful enough to deploy no airbags but still caused our client's head and neck to whip violently forward and back, a
mechanism that is well documented as the cause of soft-tissue cervical injury.
Following the collision, our client sought prompt medical attention and was diagnosed with a cervical strain consistent
with whiplash. Treatment has included physical therapy, prescribed medication, and a course of chiropractic care.
Our client continues to experience neck stiffness, persistent headaches, and reduced range of motion, which have
interfered with daily work responsibilities and recreational activities that were previously routine.
Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured failed to maintain a safe following distance and failed to stop in time, and
no reasonable explanation has been offered to the contrary. The medical records, treatment notes, and photographs
of the damaged vehicles are available for your review.
To resolve this claim without litigation, we demand payment of $75,200.00. This offer will remain open for thirty days
from the date of this letter. If we do not recevie a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without
further notice.
Expert review: William Johnson, neurologist
Sincerely,
Garrett Wallace
Gardner & Morris Law Group
</page>

Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
